estimand: The validation-selected reversible RGRC threshold policy's confirmatory false-commit, retained-recall, and recovery-cost behavior under the frozen trained system.

arms.implementation_contract: A preregistered high-evidence RGRC commit/retract/reactivate threshold tuple retaining reversible attribution and explicit unresolved mass.
A preregistered middle RGRC commit/retract/reactivate threshold tuple retaining the same ledger operations and evidence fields.
A preregistered lower-evidence RGRC threshold tuple retaining contamination, rollback, and unresolved safeguards.
Diagnostic no-commit control used only to measure headroom; it cannot be selected because it removes the frozen reversible-commit capability.

information_contract: Every threshold arm receives the identical signed evidence stream, correction timing, actor/object ontology, and ledger ancestry; confirmatory labels remain hidden.
budget_contract: Every arm receives the same threshold-search count on validation, ledger storage, replay opportunities, and correction-processing budget.
claim_boundary: Resolves only consolidation_thresholds while retaining reversible RGRC authority; it cannot resolve other bindings, validate Gate B, or authorize a seven-operator ablation.
